## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue or decision.

## Validation

List checks run, results, and unavailable checks. Include reproduction steps or visuals for game/UI changes.

## Review

- [ ] Diff contains only intended changes and no secrets or generated cache/builds.
- [ ] Relevant validation passed, or limitations are explained above.
- [ ] Documentation and project standard reflect any workflow or layout changes.
- [ ] Asset/resource references and licenses were checked where applicable.
